title: Informers Name Mehtab Singh and the Village Is Besieged

blocks.text: The Nawab now leans on collaborators, informers, and sectarian rivals to produce the names of the killers. Under threats and promises of favor, the search narrows until Harbhagat and others identify Mehtab Singh Bhangoo as the principal avenger.

Once his name is spoken, the pressure shifts to place and family. Mirankot becomes the focus of official suspicion, and Mughal officers move to seize relatives and local leaders who might reveal where Mehtab Singh has gone.
The siege is therefore investigative as well as punitive. By surrounding the village and interrogating its people, the state tries to recover lost honor through coercion and exemplary terror.
